Poems on various subjects

AUTHOR:

Wheatley, Phillis
, 1753–1784.

TITLE:

Poems on various subjects
, religious and moral, by Phillis Wheatly, negro servant to Mr. John Wheatley, of Boston, in New-England.

PUBLISHED:

London: Printed for A. Bell, Bookseller, Aldgate; and sold by Messrs. Cox and Berry, King-Street, Boston. M DCC LXXIII.

DEDICATION:

To the Right Honorable the Countess of Huntingdon, the following poems are most respectfully inscribed, by her much obliged, very humble, and devoted servant, Phillis Wheatley. Boston, June 12, 1773.
